title: A Heavenly Warning
body:
(HimmlischeHurrikane, dt.)
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Thumma salaatu wa salam, alfu salaat, alfu salaam ala Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l`Akhireen, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Dastoor yaa RijaalAllah, madad.
O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum. Try to be rijaalAllah, heroes for Allah! Try to be dressed in heavenly
“hero-ness," then whoever looks at you, his heart must tremble! There is coming such a new generation that
will be dressed with such power from Heavens, and they are the armies of Sayyidina Mahdi (a)! As-salaamu
`alaykum! As-salaamu `alaykum! Yaa Rabbana ija`l min junoodun junood Allah, “O our Lord! Make us from
the servants of Allah that are strong, supported followers.” Allahu Akbar!
Good tidings from Heavens are reaching daily more than before; speedily they are approaching to clean this

dirty world from Shaytan and its followers. Don't be from those rubbish people. People are of two kinds: one
kind is precious, and the second is from rubbish. Does a housekeeper keep what she sweeps into the dustbin,
as if it is precious?
O People! From east to west, a brush for cleaning this world is coming, as it has become so dirty! That one
who is rubbish will be taken away, with no way of escape. We are reaching the limits of the life of dunya, and
the Day of Resurrection is now approaching. Before, perhaps the names of billions of Mankind were written
as rubbish ones, and they will be taken! A cleaning is coming now, so try to be from clean ones. Perhaps this
Ramadan may be the last Ramadan for making good ones on one side and rubbish ones on the other side.
Allahu Akbar! Rubbish ones are those who are following Shaytan and its army. They are dirty, rubbish ones,
and they will be taken and put in the WC (bathroom). That is heavenly news that they are making such a
weak servant declare in this holy month for all the Muslim world, and also the unbelievers’ world. Tawbah,
yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. We do not claim to be clean ones, but we are asking
for cleanliness!
O our Attenders! Give time for your Creator, even some minutes, and it will be good for you. If you are not
giving even some minutes, your name is going to be written with rubbish ones. The Lord of Heavens never
likes rubbish ones. They may be Muslims, Christians, Jewish, Chinese, Hindus, Africans, Native Americans,
or Australians.
O People! Listen to a heavenly addressing! I am like you; I am not claiming I am this or that one, no! But I am
only appointed as a weak servant, as a warner to make people wake up, and that is all. Those who are
following their egos, their rides, those whose interest is only eating, drinking, and dressing, their names are
under the table of rubbish ones. Try to have your name written under the table of pearls, diamonds, rubies,
and emeralds! Why leave your name to be written under the table of rubbish ones? And how many kinds of
rubbish do you know? (Mawlana Shaykh addresses someone in the audience: "Don't move, such a thing is
cutting our line from the Heavens.") And what is rubbish? There are so many kinds of rubbish from all walks
of life. What you put in the WC is rubbish also, dirtiness. It is going to be a classification, "This belongs to
first-class WC people." O People! Look at which kind of rubbish you may be! They may say, "Ohh, we are not
rubbish." You do not know if you are rubbish or not, because you can't walk without drinking whiskey,

and drunk people never understand as they are heedless people.
O People! Wake up and try to be clean. This holy month is coming to make people clean. Don't travel in
sewage channels! People are mostly saying, "We take a bath everyday and we are not dirty ones." Dirtiness is
not in your physical being, but it is in your self, because you are not believing in the Lord of Heavens or
following His holy orders, and that is dirtiness for you! You may take a bath 50 times a day, but you are still
dirty ones! May Allah forgive us.
O People! I fear a cleaning is coming to all nations. Now they are making me declare heavenly warnings. Be
careful, beware that a hurricane is coming and looking for some ones to take up! But some have been
protected. Beware! Holy revenge is coming as hurricanes to those who are not following holy commands and
it will take him from Earth!
This is a holy month. I don't know what is going to happen after this holy month, but they are sending
heavenly inspirations to my heart that after Ramadan there may be so many unexpected things. The first
cleaning will come on Muslim communities who are not taking cleanliness in this holy month. Hurricanes are
coming now in so many Muslim countries, beginning first with them and then coming secondly to other
religious people, Christians and Jewish people, then to Hindus, Chinese, and Japan! The Lord of Heavens,
and those who have been granted such knowledge, know that hurricanes are approaching after this holy
month and taking billions of people!
May Allah forgive us. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Aamantu billah, "We
believe in our Lord," and what is the real truth. We believe in His Last Prophet (s) who has been sent from
the Heavens to warn people and to make them clean. People of Ahlu ’l-Sunnah wa ’l-Jama`ah and Shi`a
people are also warned, if they are not keeping and accepting truth, those hurricanes will come on them,
taking so many sleeping at night, that in the morning you can't find their bodies!
O People! We are not saying this and joking with you; it is Truth! I am trembling from heavenly punishment
or revenge, and I am fearing! I am not making an exception for myself, but all nations must ask for heavenly
protection; if not, it will be too difficult to save them! May Allah forgive us for the honor of the Seal of
Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)

Fatihah.
That is something that was never heard before, and it is important. Astaghfirullah.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sings)
Allahuma salli wa sallim `ala
Nabiyina Muhammad `alayhi 's-salaam.
Salaatan tadoomu wahtoohda `ilayh
ma marra 'l-layaali wa toola 'd-dawaam.
O Allah! Pray and send peace on
our Prophet Muhammad, upon him be peace!
Praises everlasting, to which all are guided,
as long as the nights and as long as the days!
Fatihah.
